pages.text: Two small stabilizers hung over the ring, firing down into the black hole. They hold the disc's spin steady enough to $(thing)turn into power$().$(br2)Optional: the reactor runs without them, but its spin makes no RF.

pages.name: Axial Stabilizer
pages.text: A $(num)3 x 3 x 3$() of casing: 8 coils around the top, the Axial Emitter in the middle of the bottom.

pages.title: Where they go
pages.text: One over the $(thing)north-west$() of the ring and one over the $(thing)south-east$(), clear of the laser.$(br2)Each one's center is $(num)11$() blocks west and north (or east and south) of the core and $(num)10$() blocks above it, so the emitter hangs $(num)9$() blocks up. Both must be complete.

pages.title: What they do
pages.text: Without them spin isn't turned into RF, so it isn't spent either: it climbs until the ring takes $(l:safety/failures)overspin$() stress. The console says $(thing)Spin power offline$() while either is missing.$(br2)With them, they also hold the disc against $(l:operation/rotation)precession$(): set the axial trim on the console to keep the wobble down.

pages.title: Axial Emitters
pages.text: Made from research: a $(item)Disc Stall$(), an $(item)Overspin$() and a $(item)Mass Starvation Recording$(), plus a $(item)Stabilizer Emitter$().$(br2)See the $(l:operation/research)Research Chamber$().
